description: This file defines a function get_data() that returns a data structure used to configure or generate a dashboard related to bank accounts in the ERPNext system. It specifies fields, non-standard field names, and categorized transactions for the dashboard.

methods.name: get_data()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary containing configuration data for the bank account dashboard, including field names, non-standard field names for customers and suppliers, and grouped transaction categories.
